# Insights

Monitor and troubleshoot Cloudflare One with analytics, logs, and Digital Experience Monitoring

> Links below point directly to Markdown versions of pages or to a more detailed `llms.txt` index for a section. Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix (for example, `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/`).
>
> For other Cloudflare products, see the [Cloudflare documentation directory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Insights](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/index.md): Insights resources and guides for Zero Trust analytics.

## Analytics overview

- [Cloudflare One Analytics documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/analytics-overview/llms.txt): The Cloudflare One Analytics overview provides a dashboard that reports on how Cloudflare One is protecting your organization and networks.

## Dashboards

- [Access event analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/analytics/access/index.md): Reference information for Access event analytics in Zero Trust analytics.
- [Gateway analytics (DNS, HTTP, network sessions)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/analytics/gateway/index.md): Reference information for Gateway analytics (DNS, HTTP, network sessions) in Zero Trust analytics.
- [Shadow IT SaaS analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/analytics/shadow-it-discovery/index.md): Reference information for Shadow IT SaaS analytics in Zero Trust analytics.
- [Network session analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/analytics/network-sessions/index.md): Reference information for Network session analytics in Zero Trust analytics.
- [AI security](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/analytics/ai-security/index.md): Reference information for AI security in Zero Trust analytics.
- [Application Access Report](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/analytics/application-access/index.md): Reference information for Application Access Report in Zero Trust analytics.
- [Data security analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/analytics/data-analytics/index.md): Reference information for Data security analytics in Zero Trust analytics.

## Digital experience

- [Digital Experience Monitoring documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/dex/llms.txt): Monitor device, network, and application health across your Zero Trust organization

## Network visibility

- [Network visibility documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/network-visibility/llms.txt): Record and analyze raw network traffic with packet captures to diagnose connectivity and security issues

## Logs

- [Logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/index.md): Logs resources and guides for Zero Trust analytics.
- [Dashboard logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/dashboard-logs/index.md): View user activity, policy decisions, and connection logs in the Cloudflare One dashboard.
- [Admin activity logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/dashboard-logs/admin-activity-logs/index.md): Monitor when a member on your account creates, updates, or deletes configurations.
- [Access authentication logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/dashboard-logs/access-authentication-logs/index.md): Use Access authentication logs to review authentication events and requests to protected URI paths and infrastructure targets.
- [Gateway activity logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/dashboard-logs/gateway-logs/index.md): Review DNS queries, network traffic, and HTTP requests inspected by Gateway.
- [Manage PII](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/dashboard-logs/gateway-logs/manage-pii/index.md): How Manage PII works in Zero Trust analytics.
- [SSH command logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/dashboard-logs/ssh-command-logs/index.md): Review SSH commands a user ran on a target.
- [SCIM provisioning logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/dashboard-logs/scim-logs/index.md): Reference information for SCIM provisioning logs in Zero Trust analytics.
- [Posture logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/dashboard-logs/posture-logs/index.md): Monitor the results of device posture checks performed on your users' devices.
- [Tunnel audit logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/dashboard-logs/tunnel-audit-logs/index.md): Review Cloudflare Tunnel connection events.
- [Logpush integration](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/logpush/index.md): Logpush integration in Zero Trust analytics.
- [Email security logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/logpush/email-security-logs/index.md): Email security logs in Zero Trust analytics.
- [IDS logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/logpush/ids-logs/index.md): IDS logs in Zero Trust analytics.
- [Network Firewall log filters](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/logs/logpush/network-firewall-log-filters/index.md): Network Firewall log filters in Zero Trust analytics.
